description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Generalized CLASS of the P306 decent H-02 miss: a cross-chain send (LayerZero sendAndCall / lzSend / Stargate router.swap) forwards a caller-supplied destination-gas amount (dstGasForCall) with NO minimum-gas check, so an underfunded gas value makes the destination execution fail (funds delivered, the call reverts). Two-signal: S1 a cross-chain send primitive; S2 a destination-gas param/var forwarded without a floor (no require(gas>=MIN) / min comparison). Suppress: pure view fee-estimators; an explicit min-gas check. Anchor: decent DecentEthRouter.bridgeWithPayload/_bridgeWithPayload (sendAndCall + _dstGasForCall, no floor). Does NOT detect fee miscalc, refund recipient, or replay.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 a cross-chain send primitive AND S2 a destination-gas param forwarded with no floor.
fp_controls.min_check_suppression: a require/comparison flooring the dst-gas (gas >= MIN) or a min-gas constant -> suppressed.
